title: Peeling sequences: a directional method for the three-block construction
summary: A peeling sequence of a finite planar point set is an ordering of its points, such that when the points get removed in this order, each removed point is a vertex of the current convex hull of the set. Write $g(S)$ for the number of such sequences, and $g(n)$ for the minimum of $g(S)$ over $n$-point sets in general position. We present a method which can be used to prove better upper bounds on the previously analysed recursive 3-block constructions $S_n$.
